states.eval: document.querySelectorAll('#dc-root [data-bp="content"], #dc-root [data-bp="num"]').forEach(e => e.remove()); const b = document.querySelector('#dc-root [data-bp="mission"] a'); b.style.background = 'linear-gradient(180deg,#b6ff8a 0%,#5fd83f 60%,#3fbf3a 100%)'; b.style.boxShadow = '0 2px 0 #23802a, inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.6)'; b.style.color = '#0f3d12'; b.setAttribute('data-bp', 'mbtn-ok'); b.textContent = ''; const g = document.querySelectorAll('#dc-root [data-bp="mission"] a')[1]; g.setAttribute('data-bp', 'mbtn'); g.textContent = ''; document.querySelectorAll('#dc-root a').forEach(a => { a.removeAttribute('href'); a.removeAttribute('data-on'); });
